title: ObiCai Synthetic Panel
eyebrow: Synthetic assessment data · Temp Agency roster
headline:
Ten voices from
ObiCai
lede: Ten named leaders at ObiCai Restaurant Group — the Fort Wayne hospitality company behind BakerStreet Steakhouse, The Hoppy Gnome, Gnometown Brewing, and Próximo — matched to a Temp Agency specialist persona, then simulated answering the full Future Ready assessment: the 6-question Check and the 20 questions that only appear in the Full.
notice: Real people hold these jobs at a real restaurant group. Nothing here reflects anything they have said, believe, or would score, and nothing here should be read as a claim about any individual's conduct or views. This panel exists to stress-test the assessment instrument with plausible, differentiated synthetic respondents.
panel_note: Twelve people are named in the source research; the ten with actual biographies are simulated here. Alyssa Gross and David Khan appear only as names in an org chart, so there was nothing to build a respondent from. This is the first panel with real frontline depth — five of the ten run a dining room or a kitchen, hold end-user authority, and hold no budget authority at all. Each person drew a different persona, so no two respondents reason the same way.
footer: Source documents: ObiCai Restaurant Group: Organizational Profile, SWOT Analysis, and Product-Market Fit Assessment; Future Ready Check (6 questions); Future Ready Full (20 additional questions).

Third run of the same pipeline. questions.json parsed from the source documents is byte-identical to the Community Harvest and Pyromation panels, so differences between panels come from respondents rather than the instrument.
Personas drawn from the Temp Agency roster — 24 built specialist profiles.
Each respondent wrote an in-character reflection before seeing any question, and was given no information about how the scale is scored.
Synthetic data. Not real respondent data.
